purpose: Teach: 風貌/可憐/阿呆/ガマン/物々交換/生まれ変わっ/とやかく/おのれ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが穏やかな風貌で迎えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad will welcome you with such a gentle expression.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft pride in her voice. Unhurried — she's painting a picture for him to see. Gentle anchor on 'Dad.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、可憐なお花を見つけたよ
lines.en: Mom, I found the most delicate little flowers.
lines.style: Bright excitement without shouting. Quick pace — he's eager to share. Open wonder in his voice, leaning forward slightly. A six-year-old's genuine delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を阿呆呼ばわりしないようにね
lines.en: Sho, let's not call your friends foolish names, all right?
lines.style: Gentle firmness — not scolding, redirecting. Even tone, clear instruction. She's kind about it. Steady gaze, no lecture-voice. The phrase lands gently but lands.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、おやつのガマンができるようになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I can stop eating snacks now when I'm supposed to.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. He's not bragging — he's sharing something real. Slow, careful pace. A small boy proud of something hard he did. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが昔は物々交換が普通だったって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was telling me that a long time ago, bartering was just how people did things.
lines.style: Thoughtful, processing something he's learned. Slower cadence — he's turning it over in his mind. Respect in his voice for what Grandpa said. Wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、生まれ変わっても今のお父さんが良いよ
lines.en: Mom, even if I'm born again in another life, I want Dad again.
lines.style: Simple and direct, no performance. Certain in a quiet six-year-old way. Soft voice, steady — he means it completely. Trailing warmth on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご近所の事をとやかく言うのはやめましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's not gossip about the neighbors, shall we?
lines.style: Kind redirection — the same gentle firmness as before. Composed, unhurried. A mother guiding without shaming. Light touch on the boundary.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「おのれを律する事が大事」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said that learning to have discipline over yourself — that's what really matters.
lines.style: Earnest, absorbing something important. Close to her, wanting her to know he heard. Respectful tone for his father's words. Sincere, not performed. Soft landing at the end.
